hero.desc_sr: Zalihe, narudžbine, projekti i finansije — sve na jednom mestu. Lagani web alat za male online prodavce, agencije i zanatlije.
hero.desc_en: Stock, orders, projects, and finances — all in one place. A lightweight web tool for small online sellers, agencies, and artisans.
hero.note_sr: ✓ Bez kartice · ✓ Setup u 5 minuta · ✓ Otkaži kad hoćeš
hero.note_en: ✓ No credit card · ✓ 5-minute setup · ✓ Cancel anytime

features.desc_sr: Vodi proizvode, narudžbine i kanale prodaje (Etsy, Shopify, Instagram). Automatsko smanjenje zaliha i PDF fakture.
features.desc_en: Manage products, orders, and sales channels (Etsy, Shopify, Instagram). Automatic stock deduction and PDF invoices.

features.desc_sr: Vidi tačno koliko zarađuješ, koji kanal donosi najviše i koji proizvodi gube novac. Prihod, profit i marža.
features.desc_en: See exactly how much you earn, which channel brings the most, and which products lose money. Revenue, profit, and margin.

features.desc_sr: Za agencije i konsultante — prati sate, troškove i profit po projektu uz automatski alarm za prekoračenje budžeta.
features.desc_en: For agencies and consultants — track hours, costs, and profit per project with automatic budget alerts.

features.desc_sr: Imenik dobavljača, računi nabavke sa upload-om skeniranih računa i precizno praćenje dugovanja.
features.desc_en: Supplier directory, purchase invoices with scanned document upload, and precise debt tracking.

faq.q_sr: Da li treba da instaliram nešto?
faq.q_en: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a_sr: Ne. MicroStock Cloud radi u browseru. Otvoriš link, prijaviš se i počneš. Desktop verzija se instalira jednim klikom na .exe fajl.
faq.a_en: No. MicroStock Cloud runs in your browser. Open the link, sign in, and start. The Desktop version installs with a single click on the .exe file.

faq.q_sr: Šta se dešava ako prekinem pretplatu?
faq.q_en: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a_sr: Podaci ostaju sačuvani 30 dana. Možeš da ih izvezeš u CSV-u u svakom trenutku. Ako kupiš Standalone verziju, podaci su zauvek tvoji.
faq.a_en: Data is kept for 30 days. You can export it to CSV at any time. If you purchase the Standalone version, the data is yours forever.

faq.q_en: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a_sr: Da. MicroStock je PWA — instaliraš ga kao aplikaciju na home screen. Radi i offline za osnovne stvari, a tu je i ugrađeni QR skener.
faq.a_en: Yes. MicroStock is a PWA — install it as an app on your home screen. It works offline for basic tasks, and there's a built-in QR scanner.
